INSERT INTO mdf_dataset_version_manifest (dataset_version_id, bar_id, canonical_symbol, trade_date, row_hash, source_type, source_id, included_at) VALUES
(#{item.datasetVersionId}, #{item.barId}, #{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.rowHash}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.sourceId}, #{item.includedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_hash = VALUES(row_hash), source_type = VALUES(source_type), source_id = VALUES(source_id), included_at = VALUES(included_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest WHERE dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId}

SELECT canonical_symbol AS canonicalSymbol, trade_date AS tradeDate, row_hash AS rowHash FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest WHERE dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId} ORDER BY canonical_symbol, trade_date

SELECT m.row_hash AS frozenHash, m.canonical_symbol AS canonicalSymbol, m.trade_date AS tradeDate, b.id AS barId, b.canonical_symbol AS barSymbol, b.trade_date AS barDate, b.open_price AS openPrice, b.high_price AS highPrice, b.low_price AS lowPrice, b.close_price AS closePrice, b.volume AS volume, b.amount AS amount, b.data_source AS dataSource, b.adjust_type AS adjustType FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest m LEFT JOIN stock_daily_bar b ON b.id = m.bar_id WHERE m.dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId} ORDER BY m.canonical_symbol, m.trade_date

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest m JOIN stock_daily_bar b ON b.id = m.bar_id WHERE m.dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId} AND (b.data_source != #{expectedDataSource} OR b.adjust_type != #{expectedAdjustType})
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trade_date) FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest WHERE dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_symbol) FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest WHERE dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId} AND trade_date = #{tradeDate}

SELECT canonical_symbol AS canonicalSymbol, COUNT(1) AS rowCount, MIN(trade_date) AS firstDate, MAX(trade_date) AS lastDate FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest WHERE dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId} GROUP BY canonical_symbol ORDER BY canonical_symbol

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest m JOIN stock_daily_bar b ON b.id = m.bar_id WHERE m.dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId} AND (b.high_price < b.low_price OR b.high_price < b.open_price OR b.high_price < b.close_price OR b.low_price > b.open_price OR b.low_price > b.close_price OR b.open_price <= 0 OR b.high_price <= 0 OR b.low_price <= 0 OR b.close_price <= 0)

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mdf_dataset_version_manifest m JOIN stock_daily_bar b ON b.id = m.bar_id WHERE m.dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId} AND (b.volume < 0 OR b.amount < 0 OR (b.volume > 0 AND (b.amount / b.volume < b.low_price OR b.amount / b.volume > b.high_price)))
